notes.title: you're just imagining it, now out on Steam!
notes.notes:
[i]You think you have a chronic illness, but you don't know what. all you know is you are always in some state of pain. you've been to too many doctors to count... but you still have to live your life.

How long will it take for you to get a diagnosis?[/i]

The chronic illness simulator [b]you're just imagining it[/b] is now out on Steam, along with a soundtrack that comes with a printable 8-page zine and HD wallpapers of the game's title menu background. 

It is also showing at [url=https://issuu.com/aesthetica_magazine/docs/aesthetica-short-film-festival-2024?fr=xPf81NTU]Aesthetica Short Film Festival[/url] in York, England starting today.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3224310/youre_just_imagining_it

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3224500/youre_just_imagining_it_soundtrack/
